Name: Roasting Marshmallows
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
With this mod you can sit next to a campfire and roast marshmallows!

Before trying to roast a marshmallow, you need to have a raw marshmallow in your inventory. Raw marshmallows can be prepared in the kitchen using one slime and one sugar.

To roast a marshmallow, sit in a chair facing a campfire and press the roast key (default [b]Space[/b]).

Once the marshmallow is cooked, press the roast key again to return you a cooked marshmallow.

Marshmallows have four stages of cooking: raw, browned, cooked, and burnt. Removing a marshmallow in one of the first two stages returns you a raw marshmallow. Removing a marshmallow in the fourth stage returns you a burnt marshmallow. Waiting too long causes the marshmallow to be burnt to ash and lost.

By default, marshmallows have the following edibility:

[list]
[*]Raw:  10
[*]Cooked: 15
[*]Burnt: 10
[/list]
This affects how much health and energy they give when eaten. You can change these values in the config.
You can specify custom campfires in the config, but they must be of the type Torch and turned On to roast marshmallows. By default, only the vanilla campfire roasts marshmallows.

You can replace the marshmallow item and stick sprites by editing the following images using content patcher:

"aedenthorn.RoastingMarshmallows_Stick/texture"
"aedenthorn.RoastingMarshmallows_RawMarshmallow/texture"
"aedenthorn.RoastingMarshmallows_CookedMarshmallow/texture"
"aedenthorn.RoastingMarshmallows_BurntMarshmallow/texture"



[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url].

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].

A list of all my mods for Stardew Valley is available at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895[/url].
